t: The last verse of a long sūrah
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟ وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanu-ṣbirū wa ṣābirū wa rābiṭū wa-ttaqu-llāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn.
m: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allāh that you may be successful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
